title: Normalized geometric restriction mate agrees with the composite right-adjoint comparison
statement: For a map a of commutative condensed rings and a scheme map f, use the functors, adjunctions and PullNormalized predicate of [def-sfb-internal-derived-scalar-comparisons]. Let b be the restriction/pullback isomorphism obtained by conjugating the termwise comparison of [def-sfb-derived-comap-upper-star-iso] with the canonical exact-left-derived comparisons. If lam : D_Y L_S ≅ L_R D_X is PullNormalized, then the geometric right mate of b inverse equals restrictPush(a,f,lam), the right-adjoint-uniqueness isomorphism for the two composite adjunctions. The equation includes the specified adjunction units and counits and requires no flatness.

source.place: Paragraphs (1) and (3), normalized canonical scalar-reduction comparison; Stacks 07A4, 0D6D, 0D6E, 07A6, 06YY and 06YP.

proof.text: Reuse the proved generic ordinaryScalarUnit calculation from IntegralResiduePullOrdinaryUnit, now for arbitrary a. Apply it degreewise and descend to homotopy categories. It identifies the scalar-adjunction unit square for the ordinary pullIso and comapUpperStarIso.

Reuse the proved generic mixedDerivedUnitFac, exactLeftSquareFac and mateModel calculations from IntegralResiduePullFlatModelMateNormalized. They compute the scalar mate of scalarRestrictionPull inverse against the derived computation counits, with the ordinary identity of step 1 as input.

The functor D_Y followed by exact geometric pullback is a left derived functor of the ordinary composite: its pasted counit is an isomorphism on K-flat complexes. PullNormalized and cancellation of the ordinary pullIso identify the inverse of b with the scalar mate just computed, by the universal property of this left derived functor.

Apply Mathlib iterated_mateEquiv_conjugateEquiv to the inverse normalized scalar/pullback comparison. Its iterated mate is the geometric restriction mate appearing in the statement, and its composite conjugate is restrictPush.hom. Expand rightAdjointUniq transported along lam to identify this conjugate.

theorem scalar_restriction_mate_normalization (a : Λ ⟶ Λ') [IsMonHom a]
    {X Y : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ Y)
    (lam : D a Y ⋙ L Λ' f ≅ L Λ f ⋙ D a X)
    (hlam : PullNormalized a f lam) :
  let b := Functor.isoWhiskerRight
      (CondensedRing.leftDerivedUpperStarIsoMapDerivedCategory Λ' f) (V a X) ≪≫
    CondensedRing.derivedComapUpperStarIso a f ≪≫
    Functor.isoWhiskerLeft (V a Y)
      (CondensedRing.leftDerivedUpperStarIsoMapDerivedCategory Λ f).symm
  (mateEquiv (adj Λ' f) (adj Λ f) (TwoSquare.mk _ _ _ _ b.inv)).natTrans =
    (restrictPush a f lam).hom
